paragraphs.text: Oret is a cartographer in Tarkir , and cousin of Anafenza . In both timelines, he became an Abzan traitor, but through different means. In the current timeline, he was originally a Dromoka Captain loyal to his cousin, but something later happened that made the clan cast him out.
Oret has a thick, dark beard.

When Anafenza was thirteen, their rolling fortress was two days out of Kavah, on the way to Arashin . Oret had hired Sultai assassin who used four zombie mastodons to topple the entire fortress, killing almost everyone inside. However, he left two survivors - the orc krumar Gvar Barzeel , and his cousin Anafenza.

Several years after Oret betrayed her, Gvar and the captain of the guard Kwaro were present at the ceremony where the clan houses swore allegiance to the newly appointed Khan Anafenza. When Oret was shown in, they waited until he recognized her. As he paled in fear, Gvar stepped up and forced Oret to his knees. Anafenza stepped down and put her sword to the throat of the man who had betrayed her, murdered her entire family, and destroyed her home. Her cousin, who had become prosperous in the ashes of their kin. He pleaded with her, saying he was the last family she had. She refuted him and cut the side of his face with her blade. Performing a blood rite before the First Tree and the eyes of their ancestors, she disowned him. He was no longer of her blood, and she declared him her enemy. If they should meet on the battlefield, he would not leave it. His spirit would be rootless, wandering alone in agony for all time. Then she bid her brother Gvar to show the traitor out.

In the current timeline, Oret stayed loyal to Anafenza, as there was little personal power to be gained among the Dromoka . He served as her Captain and aided her in fighting the encroaching Kolaghan warriors. When she bid him follow her deep into the desert in 4559 AR, he did not understand why, but he followed her nonetheless. When he realized she was using necromantic energies to defeat her foes, it was too late to stop it. Anafenza killed their foes, including the powerful Kolaghan orc Gvar Barzeel , before she was spotted by one of the dragons . To save her spirit, Oret personally killed her, allowing her soul to stay with the ancestor spirits nearby.

Upon his arrival at the city of Kavah, he was greeted as a hero. He was raised to the rank of scout captain, honored with the title of cartographer, and, with it, a life in exile. Soon, his wanderings brought him back to the canyon where Anafenza had died. Nothing remained of her body, but among the remnants of the tree were all those pieces of amber that had carried the spirits of ancestors to the site. Oret collected as many as he could find.

Using his position as cartographer, he tracked down a dead tree in the desert and placed the amber in a ring around it, carving Anafenza's name into the trunk, and hiding it with sand, then erasing the tree's location from every map in the land. Through his actions, Oret ensured that Anafenza lived on as a fierce kin-tree warrior spirit.
However, by 4564, Oret's actions in 4559 or in the 5 years since had earned him banishment from House Mevak and severance from their Kin-Tree.

Two of the Abzan flavor texts that reference Anafenza's supporting characters from Khans of Tarkir block have possible continuity errors, referencing the original, alternate timeline. However, it is possible to consolidate these discrepancies within the current timeline, as 5 years passed "off-screen" between Dragons of Tarkir and Tarkir: Dragonstorm .
